**Finding: Deviation (WARRANTY — Performance warranty and duration)**

The agreement gives us no warranty protection at all:

- **No express warranty exists.** Article VII contains only support covenants — "commercially reasonable efforts to provide Error Corrections" (p0093) and availability of Revisions (p0094) — not a conformance or workmanlike-performance warranty.
- **Article VIX is a full "AS IS" disclaimer** (p0110–p0116): all warranties express and implied disclaimed, with express negation of error-free operation, fitness for our requirements, and even that "NONCONFORMITY TO ITS DOCUMENTATION CAN OR WILL BE CORRECTED."

That combination is the playbook's walk-away position, so it fails the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with repair, replace or refund) rather than merely falling short of preferred.

**Redline (validated ok:true):**
1. Inserted an express warranty after the Article VIX heading: workmanlike services, 12-month conformance of the Licensed Technology to Documentation and Specifications, no malicious code, compliance with applicable law, with a repair / replace / re-perform / refund remedy at Licensor's option.
2. Amended p0110 to open "EXCEPT FOR THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES SET FORTH IN THIS ARTICLE, ..." so the disclaimer no longer swallows the new warranty.

The comment offers the fallback 90-day conformance period as a landing zone if Licensor pushes back on 12 months.
